Lead curse tablet. Object formed by neatly rolling cast lead sheet of thickness c.1mm with its visible end of oval form into a tube; the sheet is rolled about twice, presumably around a former. Patinated overall. The object retains reddish soil in the centre and has not been unwrapped by the finder - nor by this reporter. Suggested date: Roman, 43-410.
